1.consolidated_definition: Mirar a lo lejos para divisar algo. En Canarias, alargar, extender, proyectar el busto especialmente al asomarse a la ventana. Millares, 8-9.
1.en_consolidated_definition: To gaze out into the distance in order to catch sight of something. In the Canary Islands, to stretch or extend one's torso, especially when leaning out a window.
